text: {"answer":"If a body is present, requests computes its length with super_len(body) and sets the Content-Length header when the length is nonzero. If there is no body and the method is not GET or HEAD, it sets Content-Length to \"0\" when the header is not already present. If a body exists but its length is unavailable or zero, it does not set Content-Length and falls back to Transfer-Encoding: chunked.","file":"models.py","line":572}
